$schema_notes: Goals dataset managed by the Goals agent (.claude/agents/goals.md). Never delete a goal; change its status instead. IDs are stable strings 'g<N>' assigned at creation and never reused.

goals.title: Build the Goals + Financial Planner multi-agent system
goals.description: Design a multi-agent system where a Goals agent and a Financial Planner agent (and future agents) interact, bootstrap, and improve over time.

goals.title: Get reliable YouTube content extraction working for Jarvis
goals.description: Current caption/transcript scraping approach gets blocked by YouTube. Need a working pipeline to feed video content into the financial planner agent and other research workflows.

goals.title: Grow investable net worth past the $100k compounding threshold
goals.description: Using the GROWTH method (Gain control, Root investments, Optimize taxes, Weed out debts, Tap into income streams, Heightened discipline) to reach $100k invested in a low-cost S&P 500 index fund as fast as possible, since compounding accelerates sharply after that point.

goals.title: Harden the Jarvis hourly sync pipeline (dedupe + trigger detection)
goals.description: Hard-code a dedup check so hourly sync only ingests meetings not yet synced, and detect 'Jarvis' / 'Okay Jarvis' call-outs (scanning ~200 chars around the mention) as the signal for actionable logging instructions (food log, habit log, etc.), excluding incidental mentions.

goals.title: Keep up consistent daily habit tracking
goals.description: Log wake-up time, vitamins, and food intake consistently via Jarvis check-ins.
